name: Living For God
overview: Scripture calls believers to a singular devotion to God, emphasizing that one cannot serve both God and worldly wealth, but must love God with all their heart, soul, and mind. Living for God involves seeking His kingdom and righteousness above all else, trusting that He will provide for our needs. This life of faith is marked by transformation through the renewal of the mind, allowing believers to discern and live out God's perfect will. Ultimately, whether in life or death, Christians belong wholly to the Lord, confident that all things work together for good for those who love Him and are called according to His purpose.
